text: True or False: Pancharatnam-Berry (geometric) phase metasurfaces impose phase by rotating identical anisotropic meta-atoms, and this geometric phase is essentially wavelength-independent (broadband).
explanation: True. Rotating a half-wave-plate-like element by angle alpha imparts a geometric phase of plus or minus 2*alpha to the circular polarization components, set by the path on the Poincare sphere rather than any material resonance, so it is broadband. The trade-off is that it requires circularly polarized input and converts the polarization state.
